name: rete
description: rete: cloud-native, range-queryable RDF graph files — build them from any source, publish them anywhere, query them from Claude.

plugins.name: rete-graph
plugins.description: Skills to build and publish .rete knowledge graphs, plus the rete MCP server: SPARQL + SHACL over 60+ public datasets (and any .rete URL), entity search, dataset cards, and media preview/embedding tools.

plugins.name: semantic-site
plugins.description: Static websites from data (CSV, JSON, JSON-LD, N-Triples) where every page is HTML content, JSON-LD, a static JSON API entry and WebMCP tools for in-browser agents. Independent of rete; no framework, no build step, any static host.
